<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 182.073165. This matches the exact monoisotopic mass of C₁₃H₁₀O (C = 156.0000, H = 10 × 1.007825 = 10.07825, O = 15.994915; total = 182.073165 Da). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C13H10O.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H10O</final_answer>
